purpose: Dallas NFL Gamecast deterministic multi-participant choreography, interruption and authoritative-event reconciliation contract.

choreography.authority: Authoritative play participants and roles determine which Dallas chibis enter a scene; roster.json remains the action-inventory authority.
choreography.overflow: Participants beyond the principal budget remain represented by existing Gamecast UI rather than spawning unverified or visually colliding chibis.
choreography.sharedClock: All principals use one play-scoped animation clock so contact, ball transfer and completion beats remain synchronized.
choreography.contactRule: Contact poses may overlap only at authored contact points; silhouettes must not interpenetrate through heads, torsos or planted legs.
choreography.depthRule: Stable role-derived depth ordering is retained through an animation unless an authored crossing explicitly swaps depth.
choreography.anchorRule: Each player returns to or resolves from the locked bottom-center foot anchor; no correction may accumulate root-motion drift across plays.

interruptions.newPlay: A newer authoritative play cancels unfinished non-signature choreography from the prior play after a short safe blend-out.
interruptions.correction: An authoritative correction invalidates participant/action bindings and rebuilds from corrected truth rather than visually reversing a completed action.
interruptions.possessionChange: Football authority transfers exactly once at the authored event boundary; interrupted scenes cannot leave a detached or duplicate football.
interruptions.signatureProtection: Verified signatures may finish only while their triggering event remains authoritative; correction or new-play invalidation cancels them cleanly.
interruptions.polling: Repeated snapshots of the same event key never restart choreography or signatures.

eventReconciliation.revisionRule: A higher authoritative revision replaces prior bindings for the same play; lower or equal stale revisions cannot mutate rendered state.
eventReconciliation.participantRule: Resolve by stable player identity plus DAL team namespace; jersey number alone is never an identity key.
eventReconciliation.unknownParticipant: If a participant cannot be roster-authoritatively resolved, retain base Gamecast presentation and do not guess an asset.
eventReconciliation.unknownAction: If the resolved player's roster action inventory lacks the routed action, use the player's safe base/idle fallback without creating eligibility from disk contents.

visualInvariants.appearanceAuthority: current official Dallas headshot lock; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name
visualInvariants.scale: player-specific locked scale projected consistently across principals
visualInvariants.mirroring: Never mirror an asset in a way that reverses jersey numbers, lettering or identity-specific visible details.

checks: Multi-player scenes are deterministic and bounded to authored principal roles.
Football ownership remains singular through synchronized transfer and interruption.
New plays and authoritative corrections cannot leak stale root motion, participants or signatures.
Unknown players/actions fall back safely without guessed identity or disk-derived eligibility.
Only verified Dallas signature concepts are routed.
Visual identity, number, camera, lighting, scale, alpha and foot-anchor locks remain unchanged.
No MLB/NHL runtime or metadata dependency is introduced.
